objective: Prevent backtest overfitting, data snooping and selection bias across JNU research families, not merely within one model.
principles: Every attempted research family remains permanently visible in the trial ledger regardless of outcome.
A failed family cannot be renamed, slightly reparameterized or subset-selected to escape its prior trial history.
A DATA_INCONCLUSIVE result is not a statistical failure but its source/acquisition path remains part of research history.
Legacy families with unknown internal search multiplicity are quarantined from promotion until a genuinely new preregistered family is tested on independent data.
Only one formal information family may be active at a time.

before_run: Write immutable family ID, hypotheses, predictors, target, timing, sample, OOS method, metrics, multiple-testing family and pass thresholds.
Freeze data source/provenance and causal availability rules.
within_family: Use family-wise correction such as Holm when multiple cells/hypotheses are jointly screened.
Use block/bootstrap procedures appropriate for serial dependence.
No best-subset reporting without preserving the full family result.
cross_family: Before any final trading-strategy promotion, evaluate selection bias across all eligible strategy variants using a data-snooping-aware procedure such as White Reality Check / Hansen SPA where implementable.
Use Deflated Sharpe Ratio for any performance-based final strategy selection when Sharpe is used, accounting for multiple trials and non-normal returns.
If labels/targets overlap in time, use purging/embargo or non-overlapping evaluation rather than ordinary random cross-validation.
Final confirmation must use independent or genuinely forward data whenever available.
trading_promotion: Information-state PASS is not equal to trading PASS.
Trading promotion requires fees, spread, slippage and executable timing.
Report raw and deflated performance; do not select only the best regime unless that regime was preregistered.
A final model must retain explicit invalidation and confidence calibration.

literature.reference: Bailey & Lopez de Prado (2014), The Deflated Sharpe Ratio
literature.role: Correct performance inflation from multiple trials/selection bias and non-normal returns.

literature.reference: White (2000), A Reality Check for Data Snooping
literature.role: Test whether the best model found in a specification search truly beats a benchmark after data snooping.

literature.reference: Sullivan, Timmermann & White (1999), Data-Snooping, Technical Trading Rule Performance, and the Bootstrap
literature.role: Demonstrates why the full universe of examined trading rules must be accounted for.

promotion_rule: No JNU module or strategy may be called validated merely because a single conventional backtest is significant.

existing_implemented_overfit_stage.default_reuse_rule: New strategy-like modules that pass earlier evidence/second-engine gates should use this implemented Stage-3 machinery or a preregistered stricter successor rather than inventing a weaker validation path.
